subject: Daily AcreetionOS Update -- November 10, 2026
body:
Daily AcreetionOS Update - November 10, 2026

Dear AcreetionOS Community,

We're excited to share the latest developments from the AcreetionOS project. Our community has been actively contributing to the project, and we're grateful for their efforts. In this update, we'll cover the recent changes, updates, and achievements.

Firstly, we've seen significant progress in the Calamares installer. Cobra3282000 has made some crucial fixes to the shellprocess2 sequence entry, which was causing Calamares init failures. Additionally, cobra3282000 has updated the Calamares files, ensuring that our users have a smooth installation experience. These changes are now live in the project repository.

In other news, we've received word that OpenIndiana 2026.10 has been released. This update brings new features and improvements to the OpenIndiana ecosystem. We're always excited to see our community members contributing to other open-source projects.

Security updates have been issued by Debian and Fedora, addressing several vulnerabilities in various packages. We recommend our users to update their systems to the latest versions to ensure their security.

On the development front, cobra3282000 has made some notable commits to the project. They've added a firefox-fix package to restore window position restore on Linux and created a new package called acreetion-surf v2.0.0. Natalie has also made a significant contribution by forcing Wayland session as the default desktop environment in cobra3282000/calamares-config-wayland.

Furthermore, cobra3282000 has installed lightdm-slick-greeter to fix displaymanager job crashes in cobra3282000/calamares-config-wayland. These changes will improve the overall user experience and ensure a seamless installation process.

We're proud of our community's dedication to making AcreetionOS a better distribution. Their contributions are invaluable, and we're grateful for their hard work. If you're interested in getting involved, please join our Discord server or check out our GitHub repository.

In the coming weeks, we'll be focusing on refining our distribution and addressing any outstanding issues. We appreciate your patience and understanding as we work towards making AcreetionOS the best it can be.

Thank you for being part of the AcreetionOS community. We're excited to see what the future holds for our project, and we're grateful for your support.

Best regards,
Natalie Cole-Clift Spiva
Co-Lead Developer, AcreetionOS
